versions.changelog:
Documentation update: a diagram of how the library maps to the channel, clearer notes on tags, metadata and file properties, and a complete NFO example. No functional changes.

[Full release notes](https://github.com/milkmansson/jellyfin-plugin-tag-browser/releases/tag/v0.2.1)

name: Tag Browser
description: Adds a "Tag Browser" channel that shows a library as a folder tree. Tags are split on a separator (default ":") into nested folders, so "holiday: beach" appears under holiday > beach. Optional branches by date and library folder, and by any chosen Jellyfin property: genres, studios, production year, rating, people by role (for example directors), or what is in the file (video codec, audio language). Any branch can also be promoted to a channel of its own, and the main channel can be hidden. Videos only.
overview: Browse a library as a tree of tags, dates, folders and any metadata
